title: Cycle-of-Thought: Self-Evaluative Iterative Reasoning for Table Visual Question Answering in Document Images
abstract: arXiv:2610.32423v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-ev

translated_title: 思维循环：面向文档图像中表格视觉问答的自评估迭代推理
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展显著提升了视觉问答（VQA）的性能，但它们对表格等结构化内容的推理仍不够稳定，常常受到空间错位和逻辑幻觉的困扰。现有的改进表格视觉问答的方法通常依赖于架构修改或昂贵的监督微调（SFT），由于需要大规模的专家标注数据集和大量计算资源，这些方法的准入门槛很高。在本工作中，我们提出了Self-RefineVQA，这是一个无需训练的推理时自我纠正框架，能够在不需要额外标注数据或模型更新的情况下提升表格视觉问答的性能。受人类修改行为的启发，我们的方法使单个视觉语言模型能够迭代地扮演生成者、批评者和改进者的角色，形成一个闭环的自我反馈回路，通过提示引导的重新评估来纠正常见的推理错误……
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的推理时自我纠正框架，让单个视觉语言模型迭代地扮演生成者、批评者和改进者的角色，形成闭环自我反馈回路，无需额外标注数据或模型更新即可提升文档图像中表格视觉问答的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that enables a single VLM to iteratively act as generator, critic, and refiner in a closed self-feedback loop, improving table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates.
